Monthly payment for principal $L$:

$$P = L \frac{r}{1-(1+r)^{-n}},\quad r=APR/12$$

Total paid $=P\cdot n$, Interest $=$ Total$-L$,
Cost $=$ Interest $+$ fee.

Loan A: $r=0.069/12=0.00575$, $n=72$, fee $=800$
$(1+r)^n \approx 1.51106$
$P \approx 80000\times0.00575/0.33821 \approx \$1360.08$
Total $\approx \$97,925.92$
Interest $\approx \$17,925.92$
Cost $\approx 17925.92+800 = \$18,725.92$
